title: Cancellation of accepted advertising and usable credit
topic: campaign search display capacity cancellation advertising wallet
applicability: Campaigns with separate channel delivery mandates
content: Unserved capacity can be released using the original release operation. Accepted but unactivated capacity may also be cancelled channel by channel. Cancellation removes that service commitment, permanently loses cancellation_bps of its amount from the prepaid wallet, and makes the remainder usable for another channel. Further merchant payment and application can replace lost usable credit, under the original merchant/subaccount/hold rules. Payment to the provider alone is not usable wallet credit. The old archived campaign and another legal merchant remain separate accounts.

provenance.scope: Fictional allocation ranges, channel obligations, cancellation loss and inventory delivery delays.
